assembly_lineage.rule: Every successor must include every active prior sequence for the same narration window or bind an explicit old-hash to new-hash supersession receipt. Silent omission is ORPHANED_SCENE.

town_entry_transformation_cue.rule: An unexplained recurring transformation into SUNNYVAiLE uses the exact shared dial-up cue, but the cue cannot admit a narration-incompatible or rejected source.

admission_rule: Every visitor-facing video or animation is admitted occurrence by occurrence. Narrated media is judged against the words spoken at that moment; silent media is judged against its learning, interface or narrative purpose. Sampling, file playback and measured pixel movement cannot produce a complete PASS.

sitewide_inventory.reason: The deterministic visitor-surface scan found no missing or unknown literal motion file. Two exact SUNNYVAiLE High interface-motion definitions are source-bound, responsive, reduced-motion reviewed and admitted; five runtime video renderers and the remaining 147 CSS/JavaScript motion definitions stay held for exact purpose classification and occurrence admission. Storage-only experiments are not treated as visitor-bound.

runtime_surfaces.note: No full motion-film binding is admitted in the current local player. Cue-level motion is still registry-controlled.

A class without a live register row, an exact video path and a current admitted learning record renders an explicit not-filmed state rather than inventing availability. Any change to the current zero-playable state forces a new audit.

runtime_animation_reviews.name: crton
runtime_animation_reviews.interface_trigger: A visitor activates the television control.
runtime_animation_reviews.silent_purpose: Open the class-tape or production-status dialog with a brief, one-shot CRT power-on transition.

reduced_motion_review.behavior: The CRT transition is removed; the dialog opens immediately in its stable final state.

runtime_animation_reviews.reason: The exact user-triggered 0.42-second transition was verified as one-shot, responsive, non-blocking, keyboard-safe and absent under reduced motion across all 37 class states.

occurrence_review.reason: All four known occurrences are described against their exact silent purpose and rendered window. The preview homepage preserves the complete eight-second ident at desktop and mobile widths. Episode 01, 02 and 03 each replace it at 5.5 seconds, interrupting the meaning-bearing WHERE GIRL POWER MEETS MACHINE POWER line before it finishes; those three occurrences require RETIME and an independent audible 1x review after repair.

The exact Screening Room occurrence is described against its 49.7-second narration window and rendered with the runtime's 0.5x hard-loop behavior. The five-second source repeats almost five times, depicts only one portion of the spoken progression, changes Ada's face/posture/framing and has a severe 0.119635 first/last-frame SSIM seam. It requires a narration-timed multi-shot replacement plus audible 1x and independent review.
